Same. skip_trim (6 m: >= 2 -> 4; 1 -> 2; 0) — same. life_stage_trim (existing pet's own senior plan -> 2 off; puppy/kitten -> -2, i.e. 2 added; else 0; only that pet's plan counts) — same.

### autoship_ext_second_pet_enrollment_interval (hub "A Second Pet's Own Autoship Everyday Subscription for an Item the Household Already Receives"; baseline "Weekly Usage and Shipment Spacing for a Second Pet on the Same Item under Tailwise Autoship")
